name: WARNING: Texas Roadhouse Fresh-Baked Rolls & Honey Cinnamon Butter
whyItWorks: The fluffy yeast rolls contain gluten and high yeast fermentation, while the addictive honey cinnamon butter is loaded with fructose and dairy fat. Ingesting multiple warm rolls before a steak meal causes rapid gastric distension and postprandial cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Politely ask your server not to bring the bread basket to the table if you are sensitive to gluten or actively flaring. If in remission, limit to half a roll without butter.
